items.quote: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
items.claim: While he was still alive, Abraham gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them away from his son Isaac, eastward to the east country.
items.action: gave gifts to and sent away
items.mechanism: The text says the sons were given gifts and then sent away from Isaac during Abraham's lifetime. It does not give a reason. Reading this as a way to keep them from sharing Isaac's inheritance is an interpretation, not something the text states.
